title: olearia ramulosa var. stricta
intro: Olearia ramulosa var. stricta, commonly known as a variety of the New Zealand aster, is a flowering plant native to New Zealand. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Research has identified its therapeutic actions as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial, which may contribute to its traditional uses. The bioactive constituents of Olearia ramulosa var. stricta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
